title: Iki trigger (iki/v1)
description: Runs one of the plugin's actions by itself: when an entity of a type is created or changed, when a request arrives at a service, or on a schedule. It runs in a project only after one of the project's Admins turns it on there.

apiVersion.description: The spec version this manifest follows.

name.description: The trigger's name in snake_case. Elsewhere it is `plugin.name`.

on.description: What fires it: an entity of its type created (`entity.created`, for each project's new record) or changed (`entity.updated`), a new registry entry of a type with an identity registered (`entity.registered`, once for each identity in a registry, by the record that registered it: ADR 0115), one of a record's state fields set (`entity.state_changed`: ADR 0125), a request of its type sent to the project as a service (`request.received`, in the service's project, once: ADR 0232), or the time coming round (`schedule`). On a schedule or a request's arrival, its runs are launched as a service account the Admin who turns it on chooses. Changes a triggered run makes never fire a trigger.

schedule.description: For `on: schedule`: when it runs, in cron's five fields (minute, hour, day of the month, month, day of the week), such as `0 6 * * 1-5` for 6:00 on weekdays. At most every 5 minutes.

timezone.description: For `on: schedule`: the IANA timezone its times are in, such as `Europe/Zurich`. UTC if left out.

type.description: For `entity.created`, `entity.registered`, `entity.state_changed`, `entity.updated` and `request.received` (a request type): the entities it fires for, with their subtypes.

fields.description: For `entity.updated`: it fires only when one of these fields changed. Without them, any change fires it.

field.description: For `entity.state_changed`: the state field it watches, one of its type's.

states.description: For `entity.state_changed`: it fires only when a record's `field` is set to one of these states. Without them, any change of the field fires it.

action.description: The name of the plugin's action it runs: on the entity, or, on a schedule, on nothing.

input.description: The action's input that takes the entity. It can be left out when only one input takes the trigger's type.

params.description: The action's params, by name. A string starting with `$` is written `$$`. Those left out take their defaults.

related.description: Other inputs of the action, given the entities related to the one that fired it (ADR 0123): of the input's type, in the project, derived from it (`downstream`) or what it was derived from (`upstream`), through references, runs and the files runs read. Such as `aliquots: { direction: downstream }`, for everything a donor's withdrawn consent touches. Each input takes many; one left with none, when it isn't optional, skips the run.

additionalProperties.description: One of the action's other inputs, by name: which way, how far and through what its entities are found from the one that fired the trigger.

direction.description: `downstream`: what was derived from the entity. `upstream`: what it was derived from.

depth.description: How many edges away, at most. 10 if left out.

edges.description: Only through these: `reference` (a field names it), `run` (a run made it from it), `file` (a run made it from a file it held), `aliquot` (split from it), `transfer` (some of it was moved into it), or `used` (a draw from it was used in the other record). All if left out.

recheck.description: Computed text field showing why the edited record needs re-verification. The edit clears this action’s computed outputs and automatically launches it with the editor’s permissions.

watch_included.description: Pinned input references and the fields whose change schedules a fresh run on the dependent record.

additionalProperties.description: The fields of the record this reference names whose change schedules a fresh run for each record that refers to it, such as an oligonucleotide's `molecular_weight` for its lots.
